'''Blinding dust''' was a [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] compound used by the [[Kage Warriors/Legends|Kage Warriors]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quarzite/Legends|Quarzite]] by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The dust blinded its target for a short period, leaving it vulnerable to attack. [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] was stunned by blinding dust during a job for [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Otua Blank/Legends|Otua Blank]] on Quarzite.
